fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Gross Dollar Volume (total amount billed to customer for cleaning services), deducted monthly. There is also a mandatory Support Fee of 10% of Gross Dollar Volume covering business/support services including billing, collection, cash flow protection, and customer relations assistance. General Liability Insurance ranges from $58-$375/month initially and up to $5,000/month depending on dollar volume (optional). Coverall Accident Insurance Program is 2.4% of Gross Dollar Volume for first shareholder/member owner not to exceed $600, plus $15/month per additional shareholder/member owner (optional). Non-Conviction Janitorial Fidelity Bond is $5.95-$35/month (optional). Electronic Fund Transfer Fee is $0-$9.95 per transfer (mandatory). Operating Advance Fee is up to 10% of amount advanced. Franchise Transfer Fee is $1,500. Liquidated Damages are $500/day. Franchise Application Fee is $85 (one-time, non-refundable). No dedicated marketing/ad fund fee is disclosed; no technology fee is disclosed.
